title: Document the public knowledge base on the Papyrus marketing site
description:
Standing rule: each initiative gets a documentation story on the Papyrus marketing site when its features are live. Document the knowledge snapshot command, public wiki pages, components and how to adopt them. Conventions: PPY-ab79ea, PPY-228e8d.

```gherkin
Feature: Marketing site documentation
  Scenario: Features documented
    Given the public knowledge base features are live on a pilot site
    Then the Papyrus marketing site describes setup, the snapshot command and the components
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live 2026-10-22: https://p.apyr.us/public-knowledge-base.html (Markus twin /public-knowledge-base.md 200 text/markdown; Accept: text/markdown returns markdown; in llms.txt and sitemap.xml). Papyrus-web PR #37 merged to main (Amplify job 35 SUCCEED, papyrus-production). Covers: what readers get, the weekly workstation run, snapshot command and files, blocks with attributes and the Markus example verbatim, trend rules and cold-start table, public-safety rules, honest labelling, adoption (projection.json wiki section, suggest-an-edit form), Shipped as the pilot (counts read from shipped.anth.us index.json, asOf 2026-10-19, dated 2026-10-22). Features list (PPY-b9b038): home card 'Public topic pages' is now 'Public knowledge base' labelled Beta and linking the page; footer link added; page map, README and tests updated (npm test passes, 22 tests). Claims limited to Papyrus docs at v5.22.0; Biblicus topic-identity and typed-entities noted as in Biblicus develop, not yet in a numbered release.
